channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical flaws in enterprise infrastructure, particularly within the Microsoft ecosystem encompassing Windows operating systems, Azure cloud services, and the .NET framework. High-severity issues facilitate unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation across essential network services like DNS, DHCP, and Active Directory Federation Services, while also compromising web applications via ASP.NET Core and SQL Server. Significant risks extend to industrial control systems, IoT gateways, and developer toolchains, characterized by widespread buffer overflows, authentication bypasses, and attacks targeting AI workflows and image processing libraries.
